title: Exploratory Data Analysis
format: typst

### Question 1

*** How Big Are The Precincts? ***

### Answer 1

```{r}
precinct_sizes <- sd |>
group_by(precinct) |>
summarize(total_votes = sum(votes, na.rm = TRUE))
summary(precinct_sizes$total_votes)

# Graph for Answer
precinct_sizes |>
ggplot(aes(x = total_votes)) +
geom_histogram(bins = 40) +
    labs(title = "Distribution of Precinct Sizes",
        x = "Total Votes Cast",
        y = "Number of Precincts")
```

### Question 2

*** Which precincts had the closest races? ***

### Answer 2

```{r}
sd_long <- sd |>
select(precinct, contest, candidate, votes) |>
group_by(precinct, contest) |>
mutate(rank = rank(-votes)) |>
ungroup()

margins <- sd_long |>
filter(rank <= 2) |>
group_by(precinct, contest) |>
summarize(
    first = max(votes),
    second = min(votes),
    margin = first - second,
    .groups = "drop"
) |>
arrange(margin)
head(margins, 10)
```

### Question 3

*** Which races were the biggest blowouts(winners winning by the largest margin)? ***

### Answer 3

```{r}
contest_margins <- sd_long |>
group_by(contest) |>
summarize(
    total_votes = sum(votes),
    top_votes = max(votes),
    runner_up = sort(votes, decreasing = TRUE)[2],
    margin = top_votes - runner_up,
    margin_share = margin / total_votes,
    .groups = "drop"
) |>
arrange(desc(margin_share))
head(contest_margins, 10)
```
